footer.description: Ipulatifomu yokuqala yezobunhloli bezombusazwe e-AI yaseKenya. Yakhelwe ukhetho luka-2027.

about.storyP1: Imikhankaso yaseKenya namuhla iqhutshwa ngokuzwakala nokuhleba okuvela kubeluleki.
about.storyP2: Abanqobile nabalahlekelwe bavame ukunqunywa inhlanhla, hhayi ubuhlakani.
about.storyP4: Sakha uhlelo lapho zonke izinqumo zezombusazwe zisekelwa ubuhlakani bangempela, obuqhubekayo. Hhayi ukuqagela.
about.why3: Ukusekela okuqhubekayo kusuka kumkhankaso ngokuqondene nokubusa
about.visionText: Abaholi benza izinqumo ngokusekelwe ebuhlakani, hhayi inhlanhla.
about.p1Desc: Yakhelwe isiSwahili neSheng kusukela osukwini lokuqala. Akuyona imodeli yesiNgisi eyakhiwe kabusha eMpumalanga Afrika.
about.p2Desc: Idatha yabafakizicelo ayikaze yabelwane ngayo. Umkhankaso ngamunye ubona ubuhlakani bawo kuphela.
about.p3Desc: Intengo yakhelwe ukuze umuntu ozongenela ukhetho lokuqala lwe-MCA akwazi ukukhokhela amathuluzi afana nomkhankaso kahulumeni.
about.p4Desc: Kungcono silethe ukuqonda okukodwa okuqinisekisiwe kunokuyishumi ezinomsindo.

bios.morris: Ukuqhuba umbono nokukhula kweKampeni. Ukwakha ipulatifomu yokuqala yezobunhloli bezombusazwe eKenya ukushintsha indlela abaholi abenza ngayo izinqumo.
bios.barak: Ukwakha ingqalasizinda eyenza abezindaba baseKenya abangenazo izinto zibe ubuhlakani bomkhankaso. Ngaphambili kwakhiwe amasistimu wedatha kuma-fintech aseMpumalanga Afrika.
bios.albert: Ukwakha ipulatifomu eyinhloko - kusukela kumapayipi wedatha namamodeli e-NLP kuya kudeshibhodi emikhankaso ethembela kuyo njalo ekuseni.
bios.john: Ukubhekisisa isu lezezimali likaKampeni nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ipulatifomu iyahambisana ngokuzinzile endaweni yezombusazwe yaseKenya.
bios.anwar: Ukuhola isu lezepolitiki nobudlelwano bamakhasimende kulo lonke elaseKenya. Ukunciphisa igebe phakathi kwedatha yezobunhloli nezinqumo zomkhankaso wangempela.

contact.eaDesc: Yiba phakathi kwabaholi bezombusazwe bokuqala eKenya ukufinyelela ipulatifomu yeKampeni. Izindawo ezilinganiselwe zitholakale.
contact.partnerDesc: Ama-NGO, amafemu okuvota, izindlu zemithombo yezindaba  ake sihlole ukuthi yini esingayakha ndawonye.
contact.footerTagline: Umjikelezo wokhetho olandelayo uqala manje. Hlala phambili.

features.headerSubtitle: Amamojula amane obuhlakani asebenza ndawonye  ngakho umkhankaso wakho uhlale unolwazi olungcono kunanoma ubani omunye egumbini.
features.ctaSubtitle: Cela ukufinyelela okusheshayo noma uhlole ipulatifomu ebukhoma.
features.f1Sub: Yazi ukuthi abavoti bakho banendaba ngani njengoba kwenzeka
features.f1b1: Landelela imizwa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, izindaba nemibiko yasensimini
features.f1b2: Thola izinkinga eziqalayo ngaphambi kokuba zibe izingcindezi
features.f1b3: Gxila kuphela ezihlokweni ezithinta ngempela abavoti
features.f2Sub: Hlala ngaphambi kwazo zonke izinyathelo zomphikisi
features.f2b1: Ukuqapha zonke izitatimende zomphakathi nokuvela kwabezindaba
features.f2b3: Yakha amasu okuphikisana asekelwe eqinisweni ngemizuzwana
features.f3Sub: Lapho ongasebenzisa khona imali yokubuyisela amavoti amaningi
features.f3b2: Ukuhlangana ngokwenza ngcono ukusetshenziswa kwemali kwedijithali
features.f4Sub: Busa ngokuzethemba futhi uhlele ukuphinde ukhethiwe kusenesikhathi
features.f4b2: Ukuqapha izinkinga zomzimba ngokusebenzisa i-WhatsApp ne-SMS
features.f4b3: Thola izixwayiso kusenesikhathi maqondana nokwehla kokuvunyelwa kanye nezingozi zezombusazwe

media.headerSubtitle: Konke izintatheli nezingcweti kwezokuxhumana okudingeka zikubike iKampeni.
media.r1Desc: Amafomethi we-PNG, i-SVG namavektha ezinhlotsheni eziningi zombala.
media.r2Desc: Ama-headshots e-high resolution nezithombe zethimba zokusetshenziswa kwabezindaba.
media.r3Desc: Umlando wenkampani, incazelo yomkhiqizo, nemihlahlandlela ye-brand.
media.quote: "Ikusasa lezepolitiki laseKenya lingabaholi abathatha izinqumo ngokusekelwe kwimininingwane, hhayi ukucabanga okufundayo."
